ampliseq_results.title: nf-core/ampliseq Results
ampliseq_results.description: Output of an nf-core/ampliseq run, which provides the counts (qiime2/abundance_tables/feature-table.tsv) and taxonomy (qiime2/taxonomy/taxonomy.tsv)

metadata.title: Sample Metadata
metadata.description: CSV table with a 'sample' column naming each sample as in the counts table, and a column for each variable used in the formula or filter
metadata.errorMessage: Must be an uncompressed CSV table (.csv)

formula.description: Metadata column(s) used for statistical analysis (e.g. "colA + colB")
formula.title: Formula

filter.title: Filter Samples
filter.description: Optionally filter samples based on metadata (e.g. "colA > 10")

method.title: Statistical Method
method.description: Analysis tool used to compare the relative abundance between groups

fdr_cutoff.description: FDR-adjusted p-value threshold used to annotate significant results
fdr_cutoff.title: FDR Cutoff
